name: Shell
description: An interactive login shell, with no coding harness on top.

install.none: The harness is the login shell the platform already ships.

launch.none: The reserved shell slug withholds the harness-run convention: a command typed into this terminal would be a second shell inside the first (ADR 0086 §3).

trust.none: No agent to trust a folder.

capture.none: No agent settings or login to save back.
